home.how_it_works_subtitle: A transparent 4-step journey from discovery to official submission
home.step1_desc: Provide basic background or answer adaptive questions to identify your citizen segment.
home.step2_desc: Rules evaluate transparently without automated blackbox decisions. See why you matched.

home.trust_statement: LabhSetu is an informational guidance platform. It provides preliminary screening and document preparation assistance. Final eligibility, approval, rejection, and benefit disbursement rest strictly with the concerned government authority. Always verify crucial details with the official departmental source.
